name: AnomaliesVR
summary:
Anomalies VR is a heart-pounding horror experience that reimagines the fast-paced movement of Gorilla Tag with a terrifying twist. Set in a series of eerie, dark environments, apes must use their agility and wits to navigate through the facility while being hunted by horrifying entities. Every shadow hides a threat, and every corner could be your last.

With immersive VR movement, spine-chilling sound design, and dynamic AI-driven anomalies, no two encounters are ever the same. Work together with other play
